dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 最近、家にいても家族の理解がなく、自分だけつまらないな、と感じています。
dialogue.English: Recently, even when I'm at home, I feel that my family doesn't understand me, and that I'm the only one not having any fun.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。つまらないと思ってしまうのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you're feeling that things are dull for you.

dialogue.content: 子供が2人いるのですが、1年前に私の病気がわかり、それにより体力もないのですが
dialogue.English: I have two children, and a year ago, I was diagnosed with an illness, so I don't have much physical strength, but...

dialogue.content: 家計のために、私も働いてますし、家事も全てやっています
dialogue.English: To help with the family finances, I am also working, and I'm doing all the housework as well.

dialogue.content: お体の調子が悪いなか頑張っていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're working very hard despite not feeling well.

dialogue.content: 無理をしてますね
dialogue.English: I'm pushing myself too hard.

dialogue.content: それはおつらいですね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: つまらないと感じられてしまうようですが、日々の生活はどんな感じでおすごしでしょうか
dialogue.English: You mentioned feeling that things are dull. Could you tell me what your daily life is like?

dialogue.content: 病気がわかった頃は、家族も少し家事を手伝ってくれてたのですが
dialogue.English: When my illness was first diagnosed, my family helped out a little with the housework, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今はそれを忘れてるかのように、他の家族3人でゲームばかりしてて
dialogue.English: But now, it's as if they've forgotten about that, and the other three members of my family just play video games all the time.

dialogue.content: 私だけが頑張ってる感じがしてます
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm the only one putting in any effort.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今は一人で家事をやられてとても大変ですね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very difficult doing all the housework by yourself now.

dialogue.content: はい、疲れました
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m exhausted.

dialogue.content: 一人でこなすとなるとへとへとになってしまいますね
dialogue.English: Doing it all alone would leave anyone completely worn out.

dialogue.content: そうですね、仕事もしてますし
dialogue.English: That’s right, and I’m working as well.

dialogue.content: お仕事はお忙しいのですか？
dialogue.English: Is your work demanding?

dialogue.content: 週4で働いています
dialogue.English: I work four days a week.

dialogue.content: それは忙しいですね
dialogue.English: That sounds busy.

dialogue.content: そんな中すべてのことをお一人でこなされていたら疲れてしまいますね
dialogue.English: Handling everything by yourself in the midst of all that must be incredibly tiring.

dialogue.content: 家族にとって、私はなんなのかなーと
dialogue.English: I find myself wondering what I am to my family.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまいますよね。。。
dialogue.English: It’s understandable you’d feel that way...

dialogue.content: お子さんと夫さんがゲームをしている感じなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it your children and your husband who are playing games?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 家事をしてる間、ずっと
dialogue.English: The entire time I'm doing housework.

dialogue.content: 楽しそうですよ
dialogue.English: They look like they’re having fun.

dialogue.content: それはちょっと嫌な思いをしてしまいますね
dialogue.English: That must make you feel quite upset.

dialogue.content: そうですね、かなり
dialogue.English: Yes, very much so.

dialogue.content: 毎日そんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it like that every day?

dialogue.content: 毎日です
dialogue.English: Every day.

dialogue.content: 夫は、他の時間も自分の自由にしてますし
dialogue.English: My husband spends his other time freely as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、私にはうるさくて
dialogue.English: But he’s strict with me.

dialogue.content: たまーに友達とご飯に行けたとしても、いちいち帰宅時間など、途中で聞いてきます
dialogue.English: Even on the rare occasion I can go out to eat with friends, he keeps checking in and asking what time I’ll be home.

dialogue.content: だから、ゆっくりもできず、行くのも面倒くさくなりました
dialogue.English: So I can’t relax, and I’ve come to feel it’s a hassle to even go.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なかなか心がゆっくりできませんね
dialogue.English: I see. It’s hard to ever feel at ease.

dialogue.content: 私は家のこと、仕事、しか許されてない気分です
dialogue.English: I feel like I’m only allowed to do housework and my job.

dialogue.content: 自由がないようなお気持ちになられてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must make you feel as though you have no freedom.

dialogue.content: ないですね、実際
dialogue.English: I don't have any, really.

dialogue.content: 良い事がないなーと
dialogue.English: I feel like nothing good ever happens.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 夫さんにはいろいろとお話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried talking to your husband about these things?

dialogue.content: 病気になった頃、体力的にもつらい、自由な時間も欲しいと言ってみました
dialogue.English: When I first got sick, I tried telling him that it was physically tough and that I wanted some free time.

dialogue.content: でも、その時わかったフリをしただけで、すぐに何事もなかった感じになりましたね
dialogue.English: But he just pretended to understand at the time, and soon it was as if nothing had ever been said.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはなんだか寂しいですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel somewhat lonely.

dialogue.content: 元々聞いてくれるタイプじゃない事もわかってるので、やっぱりね、という感じです
dialogue.English: I already know he's not the type to listen, so it was more of an "I knew it" feeling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なかなかお話しづらいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult to talk to him.

dialogue.content: 言いたくないですね、もう
dialogue.English: I don’t want to say anything anymore.

dialogue.content: 話したくなくなりますよね。。。
dialogue.English: It makes you not want to talk, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: ご病気をされて少しは手伝ってくれたと先程おっしゃていましたが、それはどのくらい前のことなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that they helped a little when you got sick. How long ago was that?

dialogue.content: 1年前ですね
dialogue.English: About a year ago.

dialogue.content: １年も前から頑張っていらっしゃるのですね！
dialogue.English: You've been working so hard for a whole year!

dialogue.content: お仕事をしながら家事と子育ての両立は大変ですよね
dialogue.English: Balancing work, housework, and raising children is tough, isn't it?

dialogue.content: その前からずっと疲れていて、やっと病気が見つかった感じです
dialogue.English: I had been tired for a long time even before that, so it felt like my illness was finally discovered.

dialogue.content: 自分が生活できる程稼げていたら、家を出たいです
dialogue.English: If I could earn enough to support myself, I’d like to move out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今はお体のほうは大丈夫なんですか？
dialogue.English: How is your health right now?

dialogue.content: 疲れると、体調が悪化します
dialogue.English: When I get tired, my condition worsens.

dialogue.content: お辛い状況でお仕事もされているのですね
dialogue.English: So you're working even in such a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: 放っておくと、筋力が低下していく病気です
dialogue.English: It's a disease where my muscle strength declines if left untreated.

dialogue.content: そんなに大変なご病気を抱えられて、とても頑張っていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: You’re dealing with such a serious illness and still trying so hard.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまのお仕事だけですと、金銭的に厳しい状況なのですか？
dialogue.English: With only your income, would finances be tight?

dialogue.content: そうですね、パートですので、なかなか
dialogue.English: Yes, since I'm a part-time worker, it would be quite difficult.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 時給も低いので
dialogue.English: My hourly wage is low, too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: さきほど家をでたいとおしゃっていたのですが、夫さんとはどのような感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned wanting to leave home earlier—could you tell me more about how things are with your husband?

dialogue.content: 私を束縛しますが、良いように使ってるだけに思えます
dialogue.English: He's controlling, but it feels like he's just using me for his own convenience.

dialogue.content: 私は、もう夫に対して嫌だと思ってます
dialogue.English: I've come to dislike my husband.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。夫さんのこと嫌になってしまっているんですね．．．
dialogue.English: I see. So you've grown to dislike your husband...

dialogue.content: でも、生活できませんし、頼る人も他にいないので…
dialogue.English: But I can't support myself, and I have no one else to rely on...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは家事など手伝ってくれない以外にはどうなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Besides not helping with housework, what else is your husband like?

dialogue.content: ゴルフの練習に行って、夜中まで帰って来なかったり、自由にしてます
dialogue.English: He goes to golf practice and sometimes doesn't come home until the middle of the night; he just does as he pleases.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか！？
dialogue.English: Really!?

dialogue.content: 自分だけ好きにしてますよ
dialogue.English: He only does what he wants.

dialogue.content: それはひどいですね
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: 夫さんがいないときは、お子さんの面倒も一人でみられている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When your husband isn't home, do you take care of the children by yourself?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 夫が子供達とやるのは、ゲームだけですし
dialogue.English: The only thing my husband does with the kids is play video games.

dialogue.content: おふたりのお子さんを一人でみるのは大変ですね
dialogue.English: Taking care of two children on your own must be difficult.

dialogue.content: ちなみお子さんはおいくつなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how old are your children?

dialogue.content: 小4と中1です
dialogue.English: They’re in 4th grade and 7th grade.

dialogue.content: まだまだいろいろと面倒みないといけないお年頃ですから、一人で面倒みるとなると大変ですよね
dialogue.English: They're still at an age where they need a lot of care, so looking after them by yourself must be very tough.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: お子さんは夫さんが家事とかしないこととかはどう思っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do your children think about your husband not helping with housework and such?

dialogue.content: 子供達も、手伝ってくれたのは最初だけですし、誰も私の大変さには何も思ってないです
dialogue.English: The kids also only helped at the beginning, and no one seems to think anything of how hard it is for me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。。お一人で頑張っていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see... You’re really carrying it all on your own.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまが体調不良のときとかはどうされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you’re not feeling well, how do you manage?

dialogue.content: 無理してこなします。誰もやってくれないので
dialogue.English: I push through it. No one else will do it.

dialogue.content: 仕事も代わりがいないですし、耐えるしかありません
dialogue.English: There’s no one to cover for me at work either, so I just have to endure.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。体もなかなか休めないですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like your body doesn't get much of a chance to rest.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, it doesn't.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは体調が万全ではないことはご存じなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does your husband know that you're not in perfect health?

dialogue.content: 知ってますね、ひどいと顔の痙攣や、目が開きにくくなったりしてるので、すぐわかります
dialogue.English: He knows. When it's bad, my face twitches or it's hard for me to open my eyes, so it's obvious.

dialogue.content: でも、慣れたのかもしれません
dialogue.English: But maybe he’s gotten used to it.

dialogue.content: どうせまた、戻るでしょ、と
dialogue.English: His attitude is like, “It’ll go back to normal anyway.”

dialogue.content: えーーー
dialogue.English: Oh my.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思われていたらいたたまれないですね
dialogue.English: It must be unbearable to be thought of in that way.

dialogue.content: 本当に、なんなんでしょうね
dialogue.English: Honestly, I don’t know what to make of it.

dialogue.content: 私には良い事が何もありません
dialogue.English: There’s nothing good in my life.

dialogue.content: ネガティブになってしまいますよね。。。。
dialogue.English: It's easy to become negative in that situation...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご実家とか誰かに相談などしたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to your family of origin or anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: 父は亡くなっており、母は姉と同居していて、そちらで大変そうなので、言えませんね
dialogue.English: My father has passed away, and my mother lives with my older sister and seems to have her hands full there, so I can’t really tell her.

dialogue.content: 母と姉が同居する前は、母が唯一の理解者でした
dialogue.English: Before my mother moved in with my sister, she was the only one who understood me.

dialogue.content: 今は、母の愚痴ばかり聞く役目になってます
dialogue.English: Now, my role has become just listening to my mother's complaints.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。前はお母様が理解者で心強かったんですね
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been reassuring to have your mother as someone who understood you.

dialogue.content: 母には言えたし、泣けました
dialogue.English: I could talk to my mother and cry.

dialogue.content: 今はお母様には相談できる感じではないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel like you can’t consult with your mother now?

dialogue.content: いないですね…
dialogue.English: No, there's no one...

dialogue.content: 私って、なんなのかなーと思いながら過ごしてます
dialogue.English: I go through my days wondering what I even am.

dialogue.content: 夫の束縛により、友達とも疎遠になってしまってますし
dialogue.English: Because of my husband’s controlling behavior, I’ve become distant from my friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。寂しいですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be lonely.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは束縛されるのはどうしてなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think your husband is so controlling?

dialogue.content: なんでしょうねー
dialogue.English: I wonder why.

dialogue.content: 浮気すると思われてるのかも
dialogue.English: Maybe he thinks I'll cheat on him.

dialogue.content: 芸能人を褒めただけでも、つまらなそうにしますし
dialogue.English: Even if I just compliment a celebrity, he looks displeased.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまのこと、大好きなんですね
dialogue.English: He must really love you.

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうかね
dialogue.English: I wonder about that.

dialogue.content: 好きなら、もっと人間として扱って欲しいです
dialogue.English: If he loves me, I wish he would treat me more like a human being.

dialogue.content: もっといたわってほしいですよね
dialogue.English: You want more care and consideration, don't you?

dialogue.content: お友だちとは連絡は全くとっていないかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you not in touch with your friends at all?

dialogue.content: そうですね、会う事もほぼないので、連絡もしなくなりました
dialogue.English: That's right. We barely see each other, so we stopped keeping in touch.

dialogue.content: 会わないと連絡しづらいですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to keep in touch when you don't see each other, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 色々聞かれても、面倒くさいですしね
dialogue.English: And it's a hassle to be asked all sorts of questions.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。職場のかたとかと付き合いはあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Do you socialize with people at work?

dialogue.content: 職場でも、あまりいません
dialogue.English: Not really at work either.

dialogue.content: ランチ休憩で少し話す人がいるぐらい
dialogue.English: There's someone I talk to a little during my lunch break, but that's about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お話は雑談とかするくらいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it more like casual small talk?

dialogue.content: そうですね、本当に雑談です
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s really just small talk.

dialogue.content: 噂がまわりやすい職場なので、プライベートな事は話さないようにしています
dialogue.English: It’s a workplace where rumors spread easily, so I try not to talk about personal matters.

dialogue.content: なるほど、話が広がってしまうのは怖いですよね
dialogue.English: I see, it's scary when rumors spread like that, isn't it?

dialogue.content: どんどん話が大きくなりますね
dialogue.English: The stories just get bigger and bigger.

dialogue.content: だから、苦手です
dialogue.English: So I’m not comfortable with it.

dialogue.content: なるほど。確かに話したくないですね。相談者さまはお仕事がお休みのときは、日中はどのようにお過ごしなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. You certainly wouldn't want to share in that environment. On your days off from work, how do you usually spend your time?

dialogue.content: 子供の習い事の送り迎えや、家事をしています
dialogue.English: I do pick-ups and drop-offs for the kids' activities and do housework.

dialogue.content: 休みの日もいろいろとやることがあるんですね
dialogue.English: You have lots to do even on your days off.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 週に4日お仕事で、あとの3日は習い事の送迎や家事ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you work four days a week, and the other three are for shuttling to lessons and housework?

dialogue.content: そんな感じです
dialogue.English: That’s about right.

dialogue.content: 自分の時間をとる暇もないかんじなんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have no time for yourself.

dialogue.content: ないですね…
dialogue.English: I don’t...

dialogue.content: お仕事に行く曜日というのは決まっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are the days you work set?

dialogue.content: はい、決まってます
dialogue.English: Yes, they’re fixed.

dialogue.content: たまにおやすみすることとかはできない状況ですよね？
dialogue.English: And it’s not really possible to take occasional days off, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね、もうそういう契約なので
dialogue.English: That's right; that's the terms of my contract.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お話の途中ではありますが、本日、時間がきてしまいましたので、終了したいと思いますがよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt our conversation, but our time is up for today. Would it be all right if we conclude our session now?

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: いろいろとお話していただきありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing so much with me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Well then, take care.
